notes: Every line of the committed summary texts and gae-band outputs was re-derived from the CSVs by the validator's own code and compared byte for byte: itemOJ-run-20261018T2132Z/summary.txt: 50 lines, identical True; itemOJ-run-20261018T2132Z/routes_summary.csv: 325 lines, identical True; itemOJ-run-20261018T2132Z/ranking.csv: 37 lines, identical True; itemF-control-run-20261018T2128Z/control_summary.txt: 17 lines, identical True; gae-band/itemOJ-run-20261018T2132Z.txt: 144 lines, identical True. No line of the CSVs contradicts a summary.

Symmetry: arm R is rho on E(F_{p^2}) with the negation map (r = 64 adding walk, distinguished points, Bos-Kleinjung-Lenstra fruitless-cycle handling). The verifier computed j(E) for every replayed instance: j is never in F_p and never 0 or 1728 (char p >= 1091). So Aut(E) over the algebraic closure is {+-1}: no small-order automorphism beyond negation exists; and since j^p != j, E is not isomorphic to its conjugate E^sigma, so no GLS-style twisted Frobenius of order 2 or 4 acts on E(F_{p^2}). A map psi = phi o Frobenius built from an isogeny phi: E^sigma -> E has degree p*deg(phi) > 1, so it is not an automorphism and does not give rho equivalence classes (reasoned, not measured). Negation is therefore the strongest symmetry available to rho on these curves. Same binary and unit: arms R and IC run in the same n2_routes process and thread, on the same instance, base point and target, with the same thread-local counters (F_p mult M; F_{p^2} mul 3M, sqr 2M, inv 1I + 4M; hashing / table lookups / LA mod ell as native ops), and are priced by the same cost function. Coverage of this check: 18 distinct curves in this study's replay dumps, against 18 distinct recorded instances (distinct (p, ell) in the CSVs).
Reference strength (K6): rho steps/p at 40 bits 0.3882 +- 0.0341 against 0.886*sqrt(ell)/p = 0.3997; the reference is not weak at the gate row.

Gate three points (I = 3M, measured Jacobian op, native 0 / 0.1 / 1 GAE; 1 GAE = the row's eadd_M + 3*eadd_I = 15 M in every row): rho is cheaper at all three points for J at c = 1, 2 and 4 (IC/rho 2.76-2.98x). Distance to the matched rho at measured cost: about 2.8-3.0x at 40 bits. The full Erratum V band (12 cells incl. the IC-favourable 'one Jacobian op = one E(F_{p^2}) addition' price and I = 2 log2 p M) is unresolved for J (min 0.932-0.945, IC cheaper in 1 of 12 cells) and rho-cheaper for D (6 cells).

The GAE re-pricing (Erratum V) was written after every run; it widens the band (upper ends rise, lower ends unchanged for J) and changes no verdict. At the pinned commit the GAE definition is in n2_routes.rs gae_band and validation/gae-band/*.txt; the PROTOCOL/REPORT erratum text was committed later in dc46011b90c4ab81a9127616539fbd69bf5a2153. Its aggregate claims (J 20-40 bits 0.51-2.98, J 40 bits 0.93-2.98, D 40 bits 11.2-70.1) also match the recomputation.

limitations: Recomputation follows the producer's definitions (PROTOCOL Amendment C / Addendum H / Erratum V and the n2_routes summarize functions, which the validator read); it is an independent implementation of the same definitions, not a blind re-derivation.
Operation counts are reproducible (exact replay) but were not re-derived by a separate implementation of the arms.

A passed report makes the receipts admissible evidence; it does not support an ECDLP claim, demonstrate a speedup over rho, or authorize promotion. At the gate's three points rho is cheaper in both studies.
